title: Start 10 years earlier, end with $281k more
disclaimer: Hypothetical: $200/month at a 7% average annual return, compounded monthly. Not a guarantee or financial advice. Real returns vary.

scenes.narration: Two people invest the same two hundred dollars a month. One ends up with double. The only difference is when they started.
Emma starts investing at twenty-five. Liam waits until thirty-five. Both keep going until they're sixty-five.

visual.caption: The only difference: when they start

scenes.narration: Same two hundred a month, same hypothetical seven percent average return. Watch the gap that ten-year head start opens up.
Here's the twist. They put in almost the same amount. Emma only contributed twenty-four thousand dollars more than Liam.
But at sixty-five, the gap between them is two hundred and eighty-one thousand dollars. Same monthly amount. Time did the rest.
